overall: Narrow mappings and acceptanceRevision analysis are accurate. RF03 needs representation-gap classification; the whole-completion withdrawal trace is not a source-only OR-retraction counterexample. No demonstrated production/authentication/world-effect claim is supported by these synthetic probes.

findings.title: RF03 withdraws the conclusion, not only the first observation source
findings.reason: The reason string has no typed source-retraction semantics. Withdrawing a whole completion may legitimately invalidate it even in a system with alternative support.
findings.supported_conclusion: The S1 native API/projection does not materialize independently retractable OR witnesses; the second observation remains journal data rather than another active native support item.
findings.unsupported_conclusion: An implemented OR algorithm incorrectly invalidated w2 when only w1 was withdrawn.
findings.recommendation: Describe five observed mapping differences, with RF03 explicitly a representation gap. Do not count it as a product bug or an OR algorithm failure.
findings.root_response: Root agreed to use the narrower classification in the synthesis; author files were not modified by this reviewer.

probe_assessments.RF01: Creation-spec binding is absent. Automatic retirement on every newer attempt is a separate policy choice, not an inherent general-model requirement.
probe_assessments.RF02: Ordinary command history binding depends on the adapter route; a correctly bound adapter is not refuted by direct wrong-instance calls.
probe_assessments.RF03: Native support representation gap; whole-conclusion withdrawal is not source-only retraction.
probe_assessments.RF04: New-action precheck and existing-reservation dispatch are distinct stages; adapter naming and use can preserve both.
probe_assessments.RF05: Default current-result does not establish independently observed q-scoped usability; the probe does not show a real artifact was unavailable.

acceptance_revision_assessment.derivation: Accept token counter 0; store acceptance counter 0; increment task counter to 1; current-acceptance remains true while a new request using token 0 is stale.
